name: Freelzebub
look: a tall lanky blue devil with two great swept horns, yellow slanted eyes and a fanged grimace, spiked shoulders, long thin clawed arms, spiked knees, taloned feet and a long spade-tipped tail
entry: A frost devil said to ride the first blizzard of winter down from the mountains. Its grin is the last warmth a lost traveller sees; where it walks, ponds freeze solid in a single night.
how: Evolve Fridgimp at level 45 while it's snowing.
Wild: rare on peaks and glaciers at night.
